To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) serious games can have a positive impact on the acquisition of knowledge and skills; (b) the effectiveness of a game depends on its difficulty, its length, and the time players invest into it; (c) the effectiveness is also influenced by the player's prior knowledge and the player's learning style; (d) the effectiveness of the game can be increased by providing the player with a learning strategy and by providing feedback on the performance of the player.
